name: P-HEL 20 kW laser (AV LOCUST)
description: Palletized 20 kW-class high-energy laser (AeroVironment LOCUST), fielded for base defense. No engagement range has ever been published: the 3 km ring is a planning figure.

outputPowerKw.condition: 20 kW-class LOCUST laser weapon system; P-HEL is the palletized fielding of the same laser
outputPowerKw.source: AeroVironment press release on the JLTV-mounted LOCUST, quoted from the search index

beamQualityM2.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a beam quality. Open optics references put high-power multimode and combined-fibre beams at M squared of about 1.5 to 3; 2.0 is the planning value for every laser in the library.

jitterUrad.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a pointing jitter. The Airborne Laser Laboratory of the 1980s held about 25 urad and modern beam control is better, so 10 urad at 1 sigma is the planning value for every laser in the library.

apertureM.note: Planning factor: no high-energy laser programme publishes a beam director aperture. Open beam-director literature describes 30 to 50 cm apertures for weapon-class systems; 0.30 m is the planning value for every laser in the library. AeroVironment says only that the later JLTV increment carries a larger aperture beam director than the palletized one.

dwellToEffectS.note: No dwell time to defeat a drone is published for this system. The programme has released engagement results but no engagement timeline; not established by the public record.
